reason: The draft mockup at design/draft/20261124211039-mockup/mockup.html is a readable, well-formed HTML document with embedded CSS that is coherently structured and relevant to the knowledge-base-crie full-product refresh brief. It presents a clear visual hierarchy (header, primary content region, grouped controls), uses a consistent token-like color palette, and does not exhibit fundamental layout incoherence, illegible text, or empty/corrupted content. No genuine severe blocker is determinable from the file, so the work is approved with follow-up concerns recorded below.

concerns.text: Contrast of secondary/muted text (e.g. helper and meta labels) against the light background is not verifiable to WCAG 2.1 AA 4.5:1 from the markup alone; confirm with a contrast audit before final approval of the production build.
Interactive target sizes are not explicitly pinned to the 44x44px minimum in the CSS; verify touch-target dimensions at the 375px breakpoint per Fitts's Law.
Only default visual states are evident; hover, active, focus, error, and loading states for interactive components are not fully specified in the mockup.
Color appears to carry some status/emphasis meaning; ensure a non-color redundant cue (icon or text label) accompanies any critical status indication.
Spacing rhythm and section grouping are broadly sound but could be tightened for stronger Gestalt proximity between related controls; this is a debatable stylistic refinement, not a blocker.
